notes.title: BETA UPDATE Nr. 2 | TESTUPDATE WITH SEVERAL CHANGES
notes.content:
Hi all,
Sry that it neededd a time and the patch is not as big as some others but i had much important family time during christmas and new year.

First a happy new year to all.

[h1]Patch:[/h1]

[h1]New Wave and Evo System[/h1]
- Players are now no longer forced to make a evolution. You are free to play as long as you want.
- The evo System changed a bit. There are still poreevo and normal evo and the same colors like before but you can get more evos when playing longer. Instead of stopping the spawner, the evolution level now causes an Life multiplicator for enemies.
- At start the lifepoints are the same as before but after 500 Waves an Lifemultiplicator starts running. It has at the beginning still x1 which causes that you have 500 waves more then before which you can play with normal life and then it gets all 500 waves +1  ( life x1, x2, x3, x4....)
- The evo lvl (upgrades + 1 if you use evolution when the button is green enlighten) decreases this multiplicator with 1 for each level.
This means:

Evo lvl 0 :
Wave 1-999 = normal life
Wave 1000 - 1499 = Enemy HP x 2
Wave 1500 - 1999 = Enemy HP x 3
......

Evo lvl 10
Wave 1-5999 = normal life
Wave 6000 - 6499 = Enemy HP x 2
Wave 6500 - 6999 = Enemy HP x 3
......

This gives the possibility to earn more evo points each run and if you are very strong to play as long as you want  until enemies need to long or get to strong for you.

- The actual modificator can be seen in brackets behind the Wave number. If your each the wave depending on the evo level in which the Multiplicator starts (Its the same in which before this the spawner stopped working.

[h1]Bugfixes[/h1]
- the Stomper now no longer ignores the grounddigger enemies. The stomper is now shooting always and not only when an enemy is in its range

[h1]Changes[/h1]
- Changed the Wave viewer a little bit for the new System
- Changed the evo button script backend for the new system
- Changed the spawner for the new system

... Several other little inagme changes in the backend to increase performance and stability

notes.title: Update Nr. 93 | 16.June.2018
notes.content:
- Several changes to the serversided system to improve performance, stability and security.
-
[h1]New[/h1]
- Added world state system

[h1]About the world state system[/h1]
- The world state system counts data about kills of users and sends them to the server. This data does at the moment not give any game changes. We are planing to add depending on community activity some buffs and unlocks but before we can add them we need to research the actual base values how much kills approximately are done of players in 24hours. depending on this data we will balance in next weeks buffs and unlocks which depending on this values will unlock and get locked (buffs, pets, heroes,....) 
The system always shows the last 24 hours and has no start/end date. data older then 24 hours will get deleted from database completely automatically and all data from the last 24 hours will be shown on in the information tab.
The shown values in the information tab are not player based data, they are the kill numbers of all players globally and this system is planned to get a main part to unlock some things for a globally community based extra

If you don't want to parcipate in this system you can change the game to offline mode in the settings but then server sided systems are deactivated ingame (offline gain system, world state system) and you will later also don't get unlocks from community systems. We hope much players will help us getting a good value of approximately kills to make a good balancing for this system.

[h1]What will be saved in the databank? [/h1]
We only save the specific time when the data was released, the number of kills of the enemies and the steam account number to find cheating peoples to block them later from this system.

[h1]About the Loading screen[/h1]
- Why do we need now a loading screen and before not?. Before the update we had much less animations and different buttons. We added more detailed animations, added premade buttons for categories and other things, added better rgaphics and much more. This needs more preloading time of graphics which would cause lags and or waiting times with no window reaction for some or most players. Before the patch the times were vere short and we set them to different windows before start of the game and nearly noone saw that there are loading processes in the background. No with the change we had some delays of 2 or 3 seconds of loading time which looked like a game freeze and some lags at the beginning of the game which were able to cause problems with the asynch. functions. The avoid problems and show players that it is no freeze or lag we added an loading screen were the player can see what the game makes at this point and what happens. The time from start to get ingame is the same as there would not be an loading screen, but the screen itself makes it clearer why there is a little more waiting time. The loading should only need a few seconds (around 5 seconds for most players). If it needs much longer or does not load after the screen please write us in discord or the steam discussion board.

[h1]About the crystal autocollecting without pets[/h1]
- The crystals have now a 10% chance that they are not dropping to the ground and are directly collected into the storage. This improves the idle gameplay possibility on beginning when palyers have no collectors because they get approximately 10% of the crystals also without collecting them or when players are idle and have no collector pet.

[h1]About the deletion of the skins:[/h1]
- We are reworking the complete design and skins. First we make a new design for the default skin and to make sure the player does not get crashes from incompatibility of the upcoming new default skin and the special skills we are deactivating the skins until the remake of them is completed (no eta yet)

[h1]About the manual backup system:[/h1]
- When pressing F1 the game saves the actual state and creates an backup of the files in an extra folder at the save game folder. This savegame will only get overwritten when again pressing F1 and is secure from every automatically used save system.

[h1]About the offline gain system:[/h1]
- The offline system is server time based and is only available when online. 
- If you are online the game is syncronising an internal time in specific times and gives a new ressource named SC (Shadow crystals). 
- Every SC is worth 1 hour 
- When getting offline the game is saving the actual server time and when getting back into the game it syncronises times, calculates the time difference and gives for every full hour and Sc you earn an specific value of ressources.
- The ressources are at the beginning very low but you can increase them with evo upgrades.
- If youa re offline the game does not get the server time and deactivates the online mode (offline in the right upper corner). then you get 0 SC over time and the internal time stamp gets reset. When restarting the game after getting online again the game restarts gaining SC and the offline time gets automatically to 0.

[h1]Why server based?[/h1]
- We have several cheaters on the game and its hard to find much of them. When using the local clock of the computer it would be very easy to cheat with simply changing the computer clock and players would be able to get easy thousands of hours offline gain daily. To stop his possibility it was impossible to stop the offline gain when offline and only making it possible to use online.

((((Basevalue x Skills) x Bonis of DLCS) x Bonus of enemystrenghe value) x bonus of multiplier)

speeder: 1dmg/explvl
arrow: 3dmg/explvl

farmer: can not lvl yet. planned in future.
